result.summary: Headings in an included page no longer get "Edit this section" links and no longer count as sections of the page. The full non-system suite passes: 6066 runs, 0 failures, 0 errors, 64 skips. How it works: each macro output is now wrapped in two HTML comment markers, unless the macro was defined with `:sections => true`. When `parse_sections` builds the edit links, it skips headings between these markers. Only `collapse` declares `:sections => true` today, because its headings are written in the page text. The markers are removed in the outermost `textilizable` call, so they never reach the final HTML. A counter (`@macro_depth`) keeps them in nested calls while the macro still runs. Because of this, an include inside a collapse block is also excluded. Included headings still render normally, with the anchors the outer pass already gave them before this change. Not committed, as asked.

changes.summary: inject_macros wraps the output of macros without :sections in MACRO_OUTPUT_START/END markers and tracks @macro_depth. parse_sections uses a new SECTIONS_RE regex and skips headings between markers, so @current_section counts only the page's own headings. textilizable removes the markers in the outermost call only.
New :sections macro option, documented and accepted by assert_valid_keys. New macro_sections?(name) helper. The collapse macro is now declared with :sections => true.

New test: a page with local headings, an include, and an include inside a collapse gets only section-2 and section-3 links, on the right headings. The included headings are still rendered and no marker is left in the output. Also a test that a plain include render leaves no markers.
New test: on a wiki page that includes Page_with_sections, show gives only 2 edit links, and both are on the local headings. Then edit with section=2 and section=3 opens exactly those local sections.
New test for the :sections option: a custom macro with :sections => true and one without; checks the registry flags of collapse and include and the resulting section numbers.

acceptance.criterion: On a page with local headings and an included page, only local headings get edit links and their section numbers match the numbers used when editing
acceptance.evidence: New functional test WikiControllerTest#test_show_should_not_display_section_edit_links_for_included_headings: show gives exactly 2 edit links (div#section-2 before Local-2, div#section-3 before Local-3), and GET edit section=2/3 opens the textarea with exactly 'h2. Local 2 / Text 2' and 'h2. Local 3 / Text 3'. The helper test checks the same thing in the helper output, with includes at the top level and inside collapse.

acceptance.criterion: The change is covered by tests
acceptance.evidence: Four new tests: one helper test for section links, one helper test for marker cleanup, one macros unit test for the :sections option, and one functional test for show and edit. All pass. The existing test_section_edit_links_with_collapse_macro still passes, so collapse headings keep their links.

acceptance.criterion: The existing test suite still passes
acceptance.evidence: `bin/rails test` (all tests except system tests): 6066 runs, 31679 assertions, 0 failures, 0 errors, 64 skips. The skips come from missing SCM repos, ImageMagick and LDAP. RuboCop: no offenses in the 5 changed files. System tests were not run (no UI behavior changed).
